messages:
anand: FYI nightly-eval flagged a sharp regression on pset v21, specifically 'ellipsis/punctuation' tests. Spike at 03:14 UTC. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/1923456789

_eval-bot_: nightly-eval summary - pset v21 - failure rate +12% vs baseline (v19). Top diffs: ellipsis-handling, trailing-punct generations.

maria: copying in. which change in v21 could cause punctuation shifts?

devon: did we change tokenizer or post-normalization? I only saw prompt wording edits in the diff.

sophie: I pushed pset v21 yesterday. Main edits: normalized trailing whitespace and converted some examples to use '...' for intent markers. Diff: https://git.redwood.ai/psets/compare/v19...v21

maria: can you paste a couple failing examples?

sophie: sure. failing sample (expected vs actual):
```
PROMPT: Clarify the action...
EXPECTED: Ask for more details about the action.
ACTUAL: Ask for more details about the action ?
```
another one:
```
PROMPT: Does it continue...
EXPECTED: No, it stops.
ACTUAL: No , it stops.
```

devon: looks like extra spaces before punctuation in ACTUAL. tokenizer postproc maybe collapsed differently after rebaseline.

anand: note: dedicated-dev model run used int8-quant build (quant-config=q4a) for the canary. Hosted float run didn't show the spike.

maria: that suggests quantization + prompt change interaction. qa-bot, can you run quick diff on quantized vs float outputs for these samples?

qa-bot: queued job #8932. will post slice when done.

qa-bot: results: quantized outputs show +token insertions around punctuation in 88/300 samples. float shows 6/300. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/8932

sophie: I can revert punctuation normalization in pset v21 for a canary rebaseline. Opened PR: https://git.redwood.ai/psets/pull/4527

devon: +1 revert for canary. Also add regression test that asserts no added whitespace before punctuation.

maria: agreed. schedule canary rerun tonight 23:00 PT after revert. anand will monitor eval dashboard and logs.

anand: ack. I'll watch latency and token diffs. if stable, we'll reintroduce normalization with a narrower prompt transform.

sophie: noted, will add unit test and comment in PR. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — quick turnaround on this one.
